Sonowal hails Shipping Corporation of India's role in maritime ambitions

Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal has praised the Shipping Corporation of India (SCI) as a key player in India's maritime and shipbuilding aspirations. Sonowal made these remarks as the public sector undertaking celebrated its 65th anniversary, stating that SCI will guide the nation's efforts to become a leading shipbuilding country.
